page: OVHcloud c2-60 is an x86_64 compute-focused instance provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by a dedicated 16-core Intel Haswell processor operating at a base clock speed of 3.0 GHz without Hyper-Threading (16 vCPUs and 16 physical cores). It incorporates 32 KB of L1 data cache, 4 MB of L2 cache, and 16 MB of shared L3 cache, with hardware instruction support for AVX, AES-NI, BMI2, and FMA, though lacking newer AVX-512 and AMX extensions. System memory comprises 60.0 GB of RAM (3.75 GB per core), paired with 400 GB of local SSD storage and a baseline network throughput of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark outcomes demonstrate solid mid-tier parallel execution capability, supported by the 1:1 physical-to-virtual core allocation. The server achieves a multi-core score of 24,461.89 on stress-ng and 24,191.73 on PassMark CPU, placing it firmly in the average tier across comparable cloud instances. Geekbench compilation using Clang reaches 16,463.0, and ray tracing registers 19,005.0. However, single-threaded processing reflects the older Haswell microarchitecture, yielding a Geekbench single-core score of 1,087.0 and text processing score of 1,416.0, both landing in the lower quartile.

Data handling and memory metrics place the server in the middle performance bracket. In-memory evaluation yields 25.27 million Redis SET operations per second and 10,442.31 PassMark database operations. Large-block memory bandwidth sustains 120.4 GB/sec for uncached reads and 45.09 GB/sec for uncached writes, while static web serving throughput measures 16.25 GB/sec. Conversely, CPU-based machine learning inference is a notable bottleneck: text generation hits 49.64 tokens/sec on a small 135M parameter model and drops to 6.54 tokens/sec on a 7B model, reflecting the absence of dedicated accelerators and modern vector extensions.

OVHcloud c2-60 offers balanced compute efficiency by bundling 16 dedicated physical cores with 60 GB of memory and local SSD storage. It is suitable for multi-threaded build jobs, CI/CD compilation pipelines, distributed caching layers, batch processing, and medium-scale web application serving, but less appropriate for single-thread bound routines or AI model inference.
description: OVHcloud c2-60 is a compute-focused instance featuring 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs on an Intel Haswell architecture running at 3.0 GHz, coupled with 60.0 GB of system memory (3.75 GB per core). It integrates 400 GB of local SSD storage, 1 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, and does not include GPUs. Compute benchmarks show solid multi-threaded performance, recording 24,461.89 in multi-core stress-ng and 8,250.0 in Geekbench multi-core tests, though single-core metrics fall into lower percentiles due to older IPC architecture. Memory throughput supports 25.27 million Redis SET operations per second and 120.4 GB/sec uncached read bandwidth. Lacking AVX-512, CPU-bound LLM generation is constrained. The instance delivers steady multi-threaded capacity for software compilation, CI/CD pipelines, containerized application hosting, and distributed data processing.
